question.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{5{y}^{2}}{4{z}^{2}}\cdot \frac{8xz}{y}?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we cancel any terms that appear in both a numerator and a denominator. Then, we multiply the numerators and the denominators as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5{y}^{2}}{4{z}^{2}}\cdot \frac{8xz}{y} & =\frac{5y\cdot y}{4z\cdot z}\cdot \frac{4z\cdot 2x}{y} \\  & =\frac{5y\cdot \cancel{y}}{\cancel{4z}\cdot z}\cdot \frac{\cancel{4z}\cdot 2x}{\cancel{y}} \\  & =\frac{5y}{z}\cdot \frac{2x}{1} \\  & =\frac{10xy}{z}\end{aligned}
$$
